description.value: The Contemporary Art Gallery (CAG) is a free public contemporary art institution in downtown Vancouver presenting rotating exhibitions of Canadian and international contemporary artists. Situated on the traditional territories of the xʷməθkʷəy̓əm, Sḵwx̱wú7mesh, and səlilwətaɬ peoples, it also operates a library, an archive, and a shop specialising in artists' books, editions, and catalogues. Admission is always free, making it an accessible cultural stop for cyclists passing through the city centre.
